EXPERIMENT 01 • ASYMMETRIC CRYPTOGRAPHY

Aim of the Experiment

To study, implement, and analyze the RSA (Rivest–Shamir–Adleman) Asymmetric Key Cryptosystem for key pair generation using prime numbers, computing public/private exponents, and performing numeric plaintext key encryption and decryption.

Apparatus & Environment

  • Virtual Laboratory Simulator: Interactive Browser-based Execution Sandbox.
  • Implementation Language: Python 3 / Modern Web ECMAScript with BigInt Modular Arithmetic.
  • Architecture: Client-side Cryptographic Mathematics Engine.

Prerequisites

  • Basic concepts of Number Theory and Prime Factorization.
  • Modulo Arithmetic ($A \bmod N$) and Congruence Relations.
  • Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) and Coprimality ($\gcd(a, b) = 1$).
  • Euler's Totient Function $\phi(n)$ and Bézout's Identity.
